---
title: "EvoDemo-Hyper MPM — my results"
format: pdf
params:
  species_id: 3
  rate: "SJ"
  beta: 0.15
  h2: 0.2
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(evodemohypermpm)
library(tidyverse)

# Self-contained so the template renders from anywhere (Table 1 of the paper):
species <- tibble::tibble(
  F     = c(10.9868, 4.9958, 0.9987, 0.3004, 0.2286),
  SA    = c(0.0365, 0.2000, 0.8000, 0.9300, 0.9500),
  SJ    = c(0.0965, 0.2500, 0.3850, 0.5050, 0.8000),
  gamma = c(0.9000, 0.5720, 0.4000, 0.3000, 0.0700)
)
```

This report was generated for **species `r params$species_id`** with selection on **`r params$rate`**
($\beta$ = `r params$beta`, $h^2$ = `r params$h2`).

```{r}
#| echo: false
sp  <- params$species_id
out <- MPM(h2 = params$h2, Vp = 1, Beta = params$beta,
           Fe = species$F[sp], SA = species$SA[sp], SJ = species$SJ[sp],
           S0 = species$SJ[sp], Y = species$gamma[sp],
           selectedrate = params$rate)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Mean breeding value through time."
out$properties_per_year |>
  ggplot(aes(year, M_EBVS)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, colour = "#3E6E83") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Mean breeding value")
```

- Generation time: `r round(out$T_GEN, 2)` years
- Realised adaptation rate per year: `r signif(out$V, 3)`
